S1.why: Number plus adjective, the noun (slot) carried by the bracket; Hungarian takes no plural after a numeral, so it holds for any count.

S2.why: Everyday phrase for 'bring on the rest': an invitation, no limit word (the vocab's 'Korlát' is kept away from this title); 16 of 20.

S3.s: Az ingyenes %lld hely betelt. A cutlingjaid ezután is ingyen működnek.
S3.back: The free 5 place filled-up. The cutlings-your after-this too free-of-charge work.
S3.why: Adjective before the number so the article stays 'az' whatever %lld is; one verb carries both 'stay free' and 'keep working'; lower-case cutling in a sentence, as the vocab sentence writes it.

S4.why: Focus on 'ingyen' before the verb puts the preverb 'el' after it, which is how a speaker stresses 'for free'; informal te as in the vocab.

S5.why: Hungarian says the whole before the part ('5-ből 3'), so positional placeholders swap the order; the case ending sits on the noun, never on a number.

S6.why: Mirrors the app's existing count label '%lld Cutling' (capital, singular after a numeral); 'akár' is the natural feature-line 'up to'.

S7.why: Uses the vocab kinds 'Szöveg' and 'Kép'; no second 'up to' because S6 above already says it.

S8.why: Hungarian lists three with no comma before 'és'.

S9.s: Egy vásárlás az Apple-fiókoddal mind a hármon érvényes.
S9.back: One purchase the Apple-Account-your-with all the three-on valid.
S9.why: 'Apple-fiók' as the vocab spells it; 'érvényes' is what Hungarians say of a ticket or pass that covers something.

S10.why: Spoken, warm and short (15 of 22); says nothing recurs without naming subscriptions, which S11 does.

S11.s: Se előfizetés, se reklám, se regisztráció.
S11.back: Neither subscription, nor advert, nor registration.
S11.why: The native 'se… se… se' frame; 'regisztráció' is the everyday word for signing up for an account.

S12.why: The wording Hungarian iOS apps use for Restore Purchases; it is 25 characters against a budget of 24, kept because the brief asks for the standard wording.

S13.why: Same noun as S12, with the ellipsis character.

S14.why: '-ért' is one of the few Hungarian suffixes with no vowel-harmony variant, so it attaches safely to any price ('1 990 Ft-ért', '4,99 $-ért'); 22 characters before the price.

S15.why: The same action noun as S14 without the price; Hungarian buttons use the -ás/-és action noun.

S16.why: What a Hungarian says to put something off kindly; it is not a refusal.

S17.why: The label iOS uses in Hungarian for close buttons.

S18.why: 'Hely' ties the title to the grid of empty slots filling the sheet; 'a tiéd' is warm and informal; exactly 20 characters.

S19.s: Köszi, hogy megvetted. Ezzel a Cutlingot és az egyetlen készítőjét támogatod.
S19.back: Thanks, that you-bought-it. With-this the Cutling-ACC and the single maker-its-ACC you-support.
S19.why: 'Köszi' matches the te register and an indie app; 'köszönjük' would say a team, and the maker is one person.

S20.s: Jó, hogy újra itt vagy. A korábbi vásárlásod visszaállt.
S20.back: Good, that again here you-are. The earlier purchase-your restored-itself.
S20.why: A Hungarian welcome back, then the fact, with no 'we' to make one maker into many.

S21.why: Same shape as S5, read aloud; whole before part, so positional placeholders.

S22.why: A noun stays singular after any numeral, so it reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21 with no plural forms; no article or suffix touches the number.

S23.s: Cutling feloldva. Most már %@ cutling fér el.
S23.back: Cutling unlocked. Now already 5 000 cutling fits.
S23.why: Bare past participle for a status ('Cutling feloldva'), the shape of the vocab's 'Korlát elérve'; app name capital, item lower-case in the sentence.

S24.why: The plain, impersonal way to say it; nobody is blamed.

S25.s: Most nem érhető el az App Store. Próbáld újra kicsit később.
S25.back: Now not reachable the App Store. Try-it again a-bit later.
S25.why: 'Most' first says it is temporary; informal imperative as everywhere else.

S26.s: Az App Store nem igazolta vissza a vásárlást.
S26.back: The App Store not confirmed back the purchase-ACC.
S26.why: 'Visszaigazol' is the word for a shop or service confirming an order or payment.

S27.s: Az itt bejelentkezett Apple-fiókkal még nem vásároltad meg a Cutlingot.
S27.back: The here signed-in Apple-Account-with yet not you-bought away the Cutling-ACC.
S27.why: 'Itt' covers iPhone and iPad without naming one; said as a fact about this account; 71 of 80.

S28.s: Az ingyenes változatba %lld cutling fér. Oldd fel egyszer a Cutlingot, és bármennyit menthetsz.
S28.back: The free version-into 5 cutling fits. Unlock once the Cutling-ACC, and any-amount you-can-save.
S28.why: 'Fér bele' is how Hungarians say what a container holds; the imperative 'Oldd fel egyszer' makes 'once' mean a single purchase; 96 of 100.

S29.why: A compact pair, because the 18-character budget leaves no room for a sentence; 'hely' is the slot word used on the sheet.

K1.why: Opens like S3; the short question invites the tap that opens Cutling; 36 of 38.

M1.why: Hungarian macOS names commands and windows with a possessed action noun ('Ablak bezárása'); this is that form.

M2.why: The same command as M1, with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: A row label, written like the vocab's labels 'Szöveges Cutling' and 'Cutlingok', so Cutling keeps its capital.

M4.why: A compact number pair; '5-ből 3' would need a suffix on a number that changes with the number.

M5.why: Participle status, matching S23 and the vocab's 'Korlát elérve'.

M6.s: Egyetlen vásárlással feloldod a Cutlingot iPhone-on, iPaden és Macen.
M6.back: Single purchase-with you-unlock the Cutling-ACC iPhone-on, iPad-on and Mac-on.
M6.why: Endings follow pronunciation: ájfon takes -on with a hyphen after the silent e, ájped and mek take -en, matching the vocab's 'Macre'.

M7.s: Ezzel az Apple-fiókkal iPhone-on, iPaden és Macen is feloldva.
M7.back: This-with the Apple-Account-with iPhone-on, iPad-on and Mac-on too unlocked.
M7.why: The account first, then the three devices with the same endings as M6, ending on the status.

M8.s: Még azelőtt vetted meg a Cutlingot, hogy ingyenes lett, így feloldva marad. Köszi, hogy támogattad.
M8.back: Still before-that you-bought away the Cutling-ACC, that free it-became, so unlocked it-stays. Thanks, that you-supported-it.
M8.why: Focus on 'azelőtt' puts the preverb after the verb; 'Köszi' as in S19.
